result.description: Built for long-form personal archives and quiet desktop backup, the Nimbus Orchard combines a compact aluminum enclosure with a 2TB mechanical hard drive and USB-C connectivity. It is designed for photos, home video libraries, and routine Time Machine-style backups, emphasizing capacity and durability over speed.
result.title: Nimbus Orchard 2TB Portable Archive Drive
result.title_description: 2TB portable archival hard drive with USB-C connectivity
